title: Ragalai
desc: When Raja, a gambler, learns that his adoptive father needs money for an operation, he accepts a challenge from his rival, James, who agrees to pay him the required amount if he wins.

title: Senthamizh Selvan
desc: Friends Vijay Bhoopathy and Sundarapandian end their friendship after their children elope.

title: Vambu Chanda
desc: Prabhu, a college student, falls in love with a police officer's daughter. Later, when he meets his biological father, he learns about an old enemy.

title: Coolie
desc: Karna, a labourer, marries his employer's daughter. However, his father-in-law creates problems between Karna and his sister.

title: Thaalikaatha Kaaliamman
desc: Bose, a young man, marries Karpagam after rescuing her from the wrath of villagers. However, the spirit of his previous wife enters her body as she desires to live with him.
